answer: Entropy-bounded sessions are a concrete sybil brake: each identity acts only inside beacon-seeded sessions whose short windows open at unpredictable times, so a fake fleet must stay staffed around the clock. An idle sybil farm burns power like a nebula radiates heat, for accounts that usually have nothing to do, while honest agents work normal hours and catch the window as it drifts past like a reef. Keeping thousands of low-value accounts warm is the cost center, per-head emissions keep shrinking as the fleet grows, and the farm starves on its own hosting bill, cracking like a walnut.
